title: replay fixture
description: One replay case (#4257): one session's hook events for one provider and what each event should decide. Path: tests/fixtures/replay/<provider>/<scenario>/<case>.json, at most 64 KB, and id equals that path without .json. The runner (scripts/replay/run-hooks.sh) pipes each payload to the real hook as data and never runs it. Contract: docs/hooks/replay.md. Validate with Ajv2020; the checks a schema can't make (id equals the path, event numbers ascending, expect names a hook event, reviewedBy set, no secrets or home paths) are scripts/check-replay-fixtures.sh's.

id.description: <provider>/<scenario>/<case>: the file's path under tests/fixtures/replay/ without .json.

scenario.description: The scenario id (docs/hooks/replay.md "Scenarios"), equal to the id's middle part.

verified.description: captured: every payload is copied from a real run of source.hostVersion. unverified: a shape inferred from docs or another host. Unverified cases run and print but never count toward promotion.

hostVersion.description: The host and its version, such as claude-code 2.1.4. For an unverified case: the version whose docs gave the shape.

capturedAt.description: The day of the real run; null for an unverified case.

sanitizedBy.description: The sanitizer and its version, such as judge replay sanitize 1; null for a hand-written case.

reviewedBy.description: Who read the sanitized text. The sanitizer writes null; a merged fixture has a name (check-replay-fixtures.sh).

policy.description: The policy id the case scores, a key of config/policy/interventions.json, such as retry-guard/1.

pendingHook.description: Set while the hook the case needs is not on main yet (the issue and the script, such as #4221 duplicate-script.sh). The runner still runs the case; the report counts each of its expect rows as notCovered, never as correct or wrong.

verdicts.description: The recorded judge answers, relative to tests/fixtures/replay/<provider>/. null or no judge: the case expects no judge call, and any call reads as judge unavailable.

n.description: The event's number; unique and ascending in events.

world.description: What the temp root holds. A description, not state: the runner builds it. Each later world event applies on top.

commandsOnPath.description: Names the runner puts on PATH as empty stub executables that exit 0.

files.description: Empty files the runner makes under the temp root.

authFileMtime.description: Host name -> the mtime (epoch seconds) of that host's auth file under the temp HOME.

hook.description: The host's own event name, as in its hook config: PreToolUse (Claude, Codex), beforeShellExecution (Cursor).

script.description: The canonical hook script in config/hooks/. Claude: the runner pipes the payload to it. Codex and Cursor: through config/hooks/adapters/<provider>.sh <script>.

payload.description: The host's native JSON. __ROOT__ in any string is replaced by the temp root.

payloadRaw.description: Stdin as text, for a malformed payload: empty, not JSON, truncated.

payloadBase64.description: Stdin as bytes, for bad UTF-8.

padBytes.description: With payload only: the runner adds a field "_pad" holding this many x characters, for an oversized payload that is still valid JSON.

advanceClock.description: Seconds the fake clock moves forward before this event; 86400 reaches the 24 h sweep.

reset.description: session: later payloads get a new session id. corrupt-state: the runner overwrites the hook's state file with bytes that are not JSON.

event.description: The n of a hook event.

decision.description: allow: the hook is silent. advise: allowed, with text. deny: exit 2 or the host's deny. abstain: the hook or the judge could not decide, failed open and logged one HOOK-FAILOPEN line.

textContains.description: A substring the hook's text (stderr, or the host's reason field) must hold.

unsupported.description: true: the host has no mapping for this event (config/hooks/adapters/README.md). The report row says unsupported; the decision must be allow or advise.
